question.text: An SSE-listed NPO provides raw beneficiary data with NO geographic tags. Per Chapter 7.3.2 sample indicator Box 7.2, which is the very FIRST livelihoods indicator an SIA should insist the SE report?

answer.text: Geographical coverage and outreach along with social composition (SC, ST, OBC, etc.)
Carbon sequestration estimates from tree planting

explanation.text: The Logic: Page 159's Box 7.2 begins the Livelihoods direct-impact indicators with Geographical coverage, followed by Outreach along with social composition (SC, ST, OBC, etc.). The keyed answer captures this opening pair, which the SIA should insist be reported first because it is foundational to every later cut of the data. The Trap: SHGs formed and gross annual household income do appear in Box 7.2 but later in the list, so they are downstream of geographic coverage and outreach. Carbon sequestration is a programme-specific indicator and not part of the Box 7.2 livelihoods opening pair. Note: Box 7.2 begins with geographic coverage and then outreach with social composition; the exact item numbering shown in the workbook should be followed rather than treating them as items I and II.
